description: A sixteen voice generative synthesiser whose two streams, Pulsar and Quasar, each feed their own last pitch and note length into the next ones

params.text: Sets how many voices are sounding, up to eight per stream, or sixteen on Pulsar alone when no Quasar output is patched; at zero with a clock in the poly jack the module runs in sync mode
Transposes everything, two octaves down at the bottom of its travel and two octaves up at the top
Chooses one of sixteen built-in scales, or one of the scales from a loaded scale file, that the generated pitches are drawn from
Sets how long a voice takes to slide to its new pitch, as a fraction of that note's own length, so short notes glide proportionally faster
Sets how wide a pitch range the generator draws from, the root alone at the bottom of its travel and about six octaves at the top
Sets the note length, sweeping from audio-rate grains at the bottom of its travel to notes tens of seconds long at the top; in sync mode it chooses the clock division instead
Morphs through the eight frames of the selected wavetable preset
Moves the peak of each note's envelope, a sharp attack with a long decay at one end and a slow swell at the other
Starts a fresh trajectory for the Pulsar voices
Starts a fresh trajectory for the Quasar voices
Holds the generator on its current pitches instead of stepping them on, while note lengths and envelopes carry on

inputs.text: Transposes everything at 1V per octave, added to the root knob
Adds to the polyphony knob, about one voice for every 1.25V; with the knob at zero it is read as a clock instead and the module steps on its rising edges
Added to the glide knob, a tenth of its travel per volt, with the total held inside that travel
Added to the spread knob, a tenth of its travel per volt, with the total held inside that travel
Added to the wave knob, a tenth of its travel per volt, with the total held inside that travel
Added to the envelope knob, a tenth of its travel per volt, with the total held inside that travel
Added to the coupling knob, a tenth of its travel per volt, with the total held inside that travel
1V or more holds the generator on its current pitches, while note lengths and envelopes carry on
1V or more starts a fresh trajectory for the Pulsar voices
1V or more starts a fresh trajectory for the Quasar voices

outputs.text: The Pulsar stream's audio, soft-clipped to roughly ±5V; with no Quasar output patched it carries both voice banks
The Quasar stream's audio, soft-clipped to roughly ±5V; it is silent while no Quasar output is patched
The pitch of the first Pulsar voice at 1V per octave, dropping to 0V while that voice is idle
10V while the first Pulsar voice is inside the gate length set in the menu, and 0V otherwise
The pitch of the first Quasar voice at 1V per octave, dropping to 0V while that voice is idle
10V while the first Quasar voice is inside the gate length set in the menu, and 0V otherwise

notes: With no Quasar output patched, both eight voice banks are summed into Pulsar and the polyphony knob reaches sixteen; patching any Quasar jack splits the streams and caps the knob at eight
Turn the polyphony knob to zero and patch a clock to the poly jack, and the module steps on that clock instead of its own timing, with the coupling knob choosing the division
The menu loads a WAV file of 256-sample frames as a custom wavetable, and a scale.txt as custom scales; both paths are stored with the patch and the defaults can be restored from the same menu
The menu can send the notes out as MIDI, Pulsar on channel 1 and Quasar on channel 2, once a driver and device are chosen
menu: Load wavetable (.wav, 256-sample frames)... — reads a mono or multichannel WAV as custom wavetable frames
Restore default wavetable — drops a loaded wavetable and goes back to the 64 built-in frames
Load scales (scale.txt)... — reads a scale file in place of the sixteen built-in scales
Restore default scales — drops a loaded scale file and goes back to the built-in scales
Driver — chooses which MIDI system the note output is sent through
Device — chooses which MIDI port the note output is sent to
Monophonic (1 voice per channel) — sends one note at a time on each MIDI channel instead of the whole stream
Gate length — sets what fraction of each note the gate outputs and the MIDI notes stay on for, from 20% to 95%
Wavetable preset — chooses which block of eight frames the wave knob morphs through
Filter type: Off, Low-pass, Band-pass, High-pass — puts a state variable filter on every voice
Filter cutoff — sets the filter's corner, sweeping from 20Hz at the lowest setting to about 18kHz at the highest
Filter resonance — sets the filter's Q, from 0.5 at the lowest setting to 10 at the highest
Wavetable index — shifts the whole wavetable selection on by a fixed number of frames
Note length — scales every generated note length, a quarter of it at the shortest setting and four times at the longest
